data.name: Actions.Play.Description
data.value: Resume playback on the current Windows media session.

data.name: Actions.Pause.Description
data.value: Pause the current Windows media session.

data.name: Actions.TogglePlayPause.Description
data.value: Toggle between playing and paused. The button follows the live playback state.

data.name: Actions.Stop.Description
data.value: Stop the current Windows media session.

data.name: Actions.Previous.Description
data.value: Go back to the previous track.

data.name: Actions.FastForward.Description
data.value: Fast forward, falling back to a 10 second skip when unsupported.

data.name: Actions.Rewind.Description
data.value: Rewind, falling back to a 10 second skip when unsupported.

data.name: Actions.SeekForward.Description
data.value: Jump forward by a number of seconds.

data.name: Actions.SeekBackward.Description
data.value: Jump backward by a number of seconds.

data.name: Actions.SeekTo.Description
data.value: Jump to an absolute position in the current track.

data.name: Actions.SeekTo.Position.Description
data.value: Position from the start of the track.

data.name: Actions.VolumeUp.Step.Description
data.value: How many percent to raise the volume by.

data.name: Actions.VolumeDown.Step.Description
data.value: How many percent to lower the volume by.

data.name: Actions.SetVolume.Description
data.value: Set the system volume to an exact value.

data.name: Actions.ToggleShuffle.Description
data.value: Toggle shuffle on the current media session.

data.name: Actions.SetShuffle.Description
data.value: Turn shuffle on or off explicitly.

data.name: Actions.CycleRepeat.Description
data.value: Step through off, repeat all and repeat one.

data.name: Actions.SetAppVolume.Description
data.value: Set one app's volume without touching the system volume.

data.name: Actions.SetAppVolume.App.Description
data.value: The app whose volume to set, e.g. Spotify.

data.name: Actions.AdjustAppVolume.Description
data.value: Raise or lower one app's volume by a number of percent.

data.name: Actions.AdjustAppVolume.App.Description
data.value: The app whose volume to adjust, e.g. Spotify.

data.name: Actions.AdjustAppVolume.Delta.Description
data.value: Percent to add. Use a negative number to lower.

data.name: Actions.MuteApp.Description
data.value: Mute one app without muting the system.

data.name: Actions.MuteApp.App.Description
data.value: The app to mute, e.g. Spotify.

data.name: Actions.UnmuteApp.App.Description
data.value: The app to unmute, e.g. Spotify.

data.name: Actions.ToggleAppMute.App.Description
data.value: The app to toggle, e.g. Spotify.

data.name: Actions.SetOutputDevice.Description
data.value: Switch the default audio output, e.g. between headphones and speakers.

data.name: Actions.SetOutputDevice.Device.Description
data.value: Part of the device name, e.g. Headphones.

data.name: Actions.CycleOutputDevice.Description
data.value: Switch to the next available audio output.

data.name: Errors.MediaCommandFailed
data.value: The media command could not be completed.

data.name: Errors.ActionNotSupported
data.value: This app does not support that action.

data.name: Errors.AppAudioSessionNotFound
data.value: No audio session was found for that app.

data.name: Errors.AudioDeviceNotFound
data.value: No audio device matches that name.

data.name: Errors.NoAudioDevices
data.value: No audio output devices are available.

data.name: Config.Playback.Description
data.value: Which app to control and the default seek behavior.

data.name: Config.Playback.PreferredApp.Description
data.value: Only control the app whose id contains this text, e.g. Spotify. Leave empty for the active session. Actions can still override this per button.

data.name: Config.Playback.SeekSeconds.Description
data.value: Seconds used by seek forward and backward when no value is set on the action.

data.name: Config.Playback.FastForwardSeconds.Description
data.value: Seconds to skip when an app does not support fast forward or rewind natively.

data.name: Config.Volume.Description
data.value: System volume behavior and safety limits.

data.name: Config.Volume.Step.Description
data.value: Percent used by volume up and down when no step is set on the action.

data.name: Config.Volume.MaxLimit.Description
data.value: Volume changes are clamped to this percent. Protects ears and speakers.

data.name: Config.Volume.UnmuteOnChange.Description
data.value: Automatically unmute when the volume is changed while muted.

data.name: Config.Updates.Description
data.value: How often the plugin polls Windows for media state.

data.name: Config.Updates.PollInterval.Description
data.value: Seconds between media state reads. Lower is livelier but busier.

data.name: Config.Updates.StatePoll.Description
data.value: Seconds between Play-Pause button state reads.

data.name: Config.Updates.IconPoll.Description
data.value: Seconds between Play-Pause button artwork checks.

data.name: Config.Updates.Extrapolate.Description
data.value: Estimate the playback position between polls while playing.

data.name: Config.Events.Description
data.value: Which changes the plugin announces to automations.

data.name: Config.Advanced.Description
data.value: Timeouts, artwork and artwork buttons. Change these only if media reads misbehave.

data.name: Config.Advanced.ButtonArtwork.Description
data.value: Show the current cover as the Play-Pause button icon.

data.name: Config.Advanced.SnapshotTimeout.Description
data.value: Seconds before a stuck media read gives up and reports no media.

data.name: Config.Advanced.ControlTimeout.Description
data.value: Seconds before a stuck play, pause or seek command gives up.

data.name: Config.Advanced.ArtworkCache.Description
data.value: How many covers are kept in memory.

data.name: Config.Advanced.Reset.Description
data.value: Turn on and complete to discard every setting on this page.

data.name: Params.App.Description
data.value: Optional: only control the app whose id contains this text, e.g. Spotify. Leave empty for the active session.

data.name: Events.TrackChanged.Description
data.value: Fires when the current track changes.

data.name: Events.PlaybackChanged.Description
data.value: Fires when playback starts, pauses or stops.

data.name: Events.VolumeChanged.Description
data.value: Fires when the system volume changes.

data.name: Events.MuteChanged.Description
data.value: Fires when the system mute state changes.

data.name: Widget.NowPlaying.Description
data.value: Shows the current track with transport controls.

data.name: Variables.SourceApp.Description
data.value: The app playing the current media.

data.name: Variables.PositionSeconds.Description
data.value: Playback position in seconds. Writing it seeks the current track.

data.name: Variables.PositionText.Description
data.value: Playback position formatted as minutes and seconds.

data.name: Variables.DurationText.Description
data.value: Track length formatted as minutes and seconds.

data.name: Variables.ProgressPercent.Description
data.value: How far through the track playback is, from 0 to 100. Writing it seeks the current track.

data.name: Variables.VolumePercent.Description
data.value: The system volume. Writing it changes the volume.

data.name: Variables.IsMuted.Description
data.value: Whether the system audio is muted. Writing it mutes or unmutes.

data.name: Variables.ShuffleEnabled.Description
data.value: Whether shuffle is active on the current session.

data.name: Variables.AlbumArtist.Description
data.value: The album artist, when it differs from the track artist.

data.name: Variables.TrackNumber.Description
data.value: The track number within its album.

data.name: Variables.TrackCount.Description
data.value: How many tracks the album holds.

data.name: Variables.Subtitle.Description
data.value: The subtitle or episode name, when the app provides one.

data.name: Variables.PlaybackRate.Description
data.value: The playback speed multiplier, e.g. 1.5 for fast podcasts.

data.name: Variables.IsLive.Description
data.value: Whether a live stream with no duration is playing.

data.name: Variables.CanPlay.Description
data.value: Whether the current app supports play right now.

data.name: Variables.CanPause.Description
data.value: Whether the current app supports pause right now.

data.name: Variables.CanStop.Description
data.value: Whether the current app supports stop right now.

data.name: Variables.CanNext.Description
data.value: Whether the current app supports skipping forward right now.

data.name: Variables.CanPrevious.Description
data.value: Whether the current app supports skipping backward right now.

data.name: Variables.CanSeek.Description
data.value: Whether the current app supports seeking right now.

data.name: Variables.CanShuffle.Description
data.value: Whether the current app supports shuffle control right now.

data.name: Variables.CanRepeat.Description
data.value: Whether the current app supports repeat control right now.

data.name: Variables.DefaultDevice.Description
data.value: The current default audio output device.

data.name: Variables.CoverAccent.Description
data.value: The dominant cover color as a hex code, for tinting your own widgets.
